challenge_basis: ASSESSMENT-0001 places material weight on EVIDENCE-0001
the watermark observation had not yet been independently reproduced
the declared assessment confidence may therefore overstate the evidentiary stability of the watermark component
resolution_note: The challenge triggered REPRODUCTION-0001. The reproduction did not reproduce the original watermark signal, new counter-evidence was incorporated into FUSION-0002, and ASSESSMENT-0002 was issued.
